baseline.method: Original conventional-source full transmission+customLM, best of two independent generic starts, USGS real data; no true site parameters

metric_definitions.site_parameters: maximum absolute difference separately IS, fullQS and FWHM, over all4specimens/all4sites, mm/s
metric_definitions.thickness: maximum absolute effective resonant optical thickness difference
metric_definitions.transmission: maximum absolute normalized transmitted intensity difference over allpoints/specimens
metric_definitions.self_consistency: maximum absolute difference declared quadrature prediction vs submitted spectrum
metric_definitions.quality: observed normalized transmission RMS separately each specimen

rationale: Per-quantity physical and absolute numerical metrics, not undefined NCC/NRMSE on scalar site values. Frozen independently from original before extraction; quality limits1.1times native original RMS. Self consistency tolerance1e-8 is a known operator numerical constraint, not a physical truth assertion.
